verdict.rationale: Phaser's documented rendering system is explicitly 2D (sprites, tilemaps, WebGL/Canvas via a 2D pipeline), and none of the evidence mentions PBR materials, global illumination/baked lighting, 3D shadow systems, or a post-processing pipeline tied to 3D rendering — only 2D filters like Glow/Blur/Shadow in the editor. Since game-engine comparisons reasonably ask about 3D rendering capability, this axis applies but Phaser shows no evidence of shipping it.
